name: quota-canvas-routing
description: Adds quota-canvas's per-worker quota verdict (one line) plus routing rules to the session start context. macOS only.

interface.shortDescription: quota-canvas verdict in the session start context
interface.longDescription: SessionStart hook runs `quota-canvas routing hook` once and adds its one-line per-worker quota verdict plus short routing rules to the session start context, so the AI picks the worker with the most headroom when it hands off work. Reads status.json only; never talks to the AI services; fail-open (silent, always exit 0) when routing is disabled or the verdict cannot be computed. macOS only.
